violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized (26 TAC §746.5013(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized
violation_type.typical_finding: A small wadding pool with rain water from the storm last week was out on the playground.  Note:  The pool was drained and moved off the playground during the inspection.
